title: feat(websocket): add opt-in bounded session recovery

target.summary: When session recovery is enabled and Recv encounters a non-retryable error, calling s.fail(err) repeats physical connection cleanup from within Recv. This can deadlock if the underlying transport's close operation waits for the receiver to exit.
notes: faulty statement: calling s.fail(err) repeats physical connection cleanup from within Recv
definition of Recv method whose behavior is wrong due to repeated transport cleanup
